summary: Byrd & CO end-to-end verification. 16/16 pytest cases pass (public, auth, invites+accept, doc CRUD, upload+status flip, quote inbox, role guards, sample client). Frontend UI verified: homepage (4 programs, 8 property types, 4 testimonials, principals Wayne+Caleb) + quote form success screen; /portal/login logs Wayne into /admin; /admin/clients invite dialog creates user, returns copyable invite link, opens client detail with 18 seeded docs incl. Resume, 3x Personal Tax Returns, 3x Business Tax Returns, Construction Budget; Add-Line creates 19th row; sample@example.com logs into /portal, file upload transitions PENDING->UPLOADED with filename/size + View button and success toast; role guards work (client visiting /admin redirects to /portal); AdsCopilot sidebar link navigates to /adscopilot preserving the internal tool. No critical bugs found.

issues: 'Made with Emergent' floating badge (bottom-right, from prior iteration) still overlays the bottom-right corner across every page; not blocking any Byrd flow because the Byrd site has no bottom-right actions, but be aware if a floating chat/CTA is added later.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~840 lines mixing Byrd (auth/portal/admin/quotes/files) with AdsCopilot (campaigns/ai/chat). Consider splitting into modules (auth.py, byrd_portal.py, adscopilot.py) — approaching the 700-line threshold.
/api/files/{file_id} streams via base64 decode from Mongo doc. Fine for MVP (15MB cap enforced) but not appropriate for real production loads; move to object storage (S3/GridFS) before scaling.
Quote model has no rate limiting or captcha — the public /api/public/quote endpoint could be abused. Fine for MVP but add basic throttling before launch.
Review request references data-testid `q-loan-amount` but the actual JSX uses `q-amount`. Not a bug (works correctly in UI), just a docs/spec drift.
AdminLayout's `admin-open-google-ads` testid is defined but review-request did not enumerate a corresponding flow — verify whether it's still needed or drop with the AdsCopilot legacy cleanup.
startup event uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event decorators — migrate to lifespan handlers before FastAPI 1.0.
